## Checklist

- [ ] `make lint` and `make test` pass
- [ ] `make audit` reports no high-severity findings, or the description explains a false positive
- [ ] New logic in Domain, use cases or view models has Swift Testing tests
- [ ] New user-facing text is in `Localizable.xcstrings` with Portuguese (Brazil) and English
- [ ] UI changes include before and after screenshots, in light and dark appearance
- [ ] Docs are updated where behaviour changed (`README.md`, `README.pt-BR.md`, `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`)
